Confidential Computing Manager

# A Single Control  Plane for Your  Confidential Computing Stack

Manage secure enclaves, verify firmware and software integrity, and uphold performance at scale. Ensure data and AI models remain protected inside Trusted Execution Environments.

[![Request a Demo](https://no-cache.hubspot.com/cta/default/3435228/b02137cd-d258-4121-ba58-7dd5c7369ed5.png)](https://cta-redirect.hubspot.com/cta/redirect/3435228/b02137cd-d258-4121-ba58-7dd5c7369ed5)

![ccm header](https://www.fortanix.com/_next/image?url=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.aglty.io%2Ffortanix%2Fplatform%2Fccm%2Fccm-header-image.png&w=3840&q=75)

## Secure AI Workloads

Create and manage Trusted Execution Environments to enforce security, sovereignty, and compliance across your AI infrastructure. Use a single control plane to configure, attest, and monitor your entire Confidential Computing stack, CPUs and GPUs. Eliminate operational complexity, the risk of unauthorized access, and exposure of data and AI models while in active use.

![Secure AI Workloads ](https://cdn.aglty.io/fortanix/platform/ccm/diagram-image.webp)

#### Simplify Operations

Provision, configure, and monitor your entire Confidential Computing infrastructure from one place. Have full control over workflows and policies, eliminate management complexity and fragmented tooling, and uphold performance as you scale.

- Available on-premises and as SaaS

![ui1](https://www.fortanix.com/_next/image?url=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.aglty.io%2Ffortanix%2Fplatform%2Fccm%2Fui1.webp&w=3840&q=75)

#### Ensure Consistent Security

Verify firmware and software integrity from a unified control plane before signaling secure key release. Composite attestation across CPU and GPU to ensure no gaps exist between independently managed components.

Supported TEEs:

- Intel TDX and AMD SEV-SNP CPUs
- NVIDIA Blackwell and Hopper GPUs

![ui2](https://www.fortanix.com/_next/image?url=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.aglty.io%2Ffortanix%2Fplatform%2Fccm%2Fui2.webp&w=3840&q=75)

#### Enable Confidential AI

Create a secure, on-demand work environment, infrastructure, software and workflow orchestration, that maintains the privacy compliance required by your organization. Safely use AI to grow and innovate and keep sensitive data and frontier models secure with Confidential Computing.

![ui3](https://www.fortanix.com/_next/image?url=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.aglty.io%2Ffortanix%2Fplatform%2Fccm%2Fui3.webp&w=3840&q=75)

![quote](https://cdn.aglty.io/fortanix/platform/ccm/quote.webp)

> “AI is foundational to the initiatives we've launched to tangibly transform pharmaceutical research and development, but models require extremely large amounts of data that often contain sensitive or personal information. Confidential Computing from Fortanix and NVIDIA essentially alleviates those privacy and security concerns while also improving model accuracy, which will prove to be a win-win situation for the entire industry.”

Hiroki Makiguchi

CTO at Xeureka

![xeureka](https://cdn.aglty.io/fortanix/solutions/use-case/enable-secure-data-driven-innovation/xeureka.webp)

## Benefits

![union](https://cdn.aglty.io/fortanix/platform/union.webp)

![ai](https://cdn.aglty.io/fortanix/platform/ccm/ai.svg)

Run Powerful AI Without Compromise

Ensure data and model weights are never exposed, eliminate insider threats, and close the attack surface across the full inference lifecycle

![compliance](https://cdn.aglty.io/fortanix/platform/ccm/compliance.svg)

Meet Compliance by Design

Cryptographic proof of data isolation at the hardware level satisfies GDPR, HIPAA, and data sovereignty requirements, turning compliance bottleneck into a built-in guarantee.

![control](https://cdn.aglty.io/fortanix/platform/ccm/control.svg)

Maintain Full Sovereignty and Control

Run AI entirely on your own terms with zero-trust architecture. Have full control over deployments, data access, and model choices.
